mu_name_from: Devias's object slot 81, which is the model index: every world but Lorencia runs its objects in one straight sequence, so type N is Object{N+1}.bmd and there is no friendlier name in the client than the number.
sheet_from: Data/Object3/*.OZJ and .OZT, from MuMain, decoded under a dv_ prefix. The prefix is load-bearing as nr_ is for Noria: assets/textures is one flat pool, and 39 of Object3's sheet names are already in it.
material_note:
show_ston01: snow along the ridge.
tile_wood04: grey weathered wooden shingles.
effects_note: Fades while the hero is indoors.
roof_fade_from: ZzzObject.cpp RenderObject, `gMapManager.WorldActive == 2`: types 81, 82, 96, 98 and 99 take AlphaTarget 0 while HeroTile == 3 || HeroTile >= 10 (the planks and the four patterned floors), 1 otherwise, eased by Alpha(o). Every roof of the kind fades together, as Lorencia's do; the indoor test is World::indoors' Devias arm.
